reference_answer: Nothing recorded about what was eaten; only that dinner there was good.
notes: Nobu being a Japanese/sushi restaurant is a fixed property of the venue, but that does NOT fix what was actually ordered on this occasion -- the fact never states the food. Rule 2a requires an occasion-specific question like this to be answered only if the fact states the detail directly; it must not be inferred from the venue's typical or famous cuisine, no matter how plausible.
